name: sector_pair_mean_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Highly correlated stocks within the same sector (e.g., HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK, TCS/INFY) temporarily diverge due to asynchronous order flow, then converge as sector-level information equilibrates. The spread between normalized prices of two co-integrated stocks reverts to its mean within 30-90 minutes during normal trading hours. This inefficiency exists because different institutional desks execute on different timing, creating temporary price discrepancies. Edge persists because monitoring and trading spread dynamics in real-time requires dedicated infrastructure.
stock_filter: pre-defined pairs with rolling 20-day correlation > 0.85 and co-integration p-value < 0.05

indicators.name: spread_halflife
indicators.formula: estimated halflife from ADF regression on rolling 500 bars

conditions: spread_zscore < -2.0 (spread is 2 SD below mean — stock A is cheap vs B)
spread_halflife < 60 (mean reversion is expected within 60 bars)
long.confirmation: spread_zscore starts reverting (spread_zscore[1] < spread_zscore, i.e., z-score turning up)

conditions: spread_zscore > 2.0 (spread is 2 SD above mean — stock A is rich vs B)
short.confirmation: spread_zscore starts reverting (spread_zscore[1] > spread_zscore, i.e., z-score turning down)

exit.stop_loss: spread_zscore reaches ±3.0 (spread widens further — cut loss)
exit.trailing_stop: move stop to breakeven when z-score crosses ±1.0 (halfway back)

risk.position_sizing: hedge_ratio_adjusted — equal dollar-risk on each leg

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.volume_filter: both legs must have volume > 50% of their 20-bar avg
filters.spread_filter: skip if either leg has spread > 0.1%
filters.event_filter: skip if either stock has results/AGM that day; skip on expiry day
other_filters: re-validate co-integration daily using 20-day rolling ADF test

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — stat arb is competitive, but intraday pairs in India are less crowded than in US

weaknesses: Two-leg execution doubles cost: 2x slippage, 2x brokerage, 2x STT — total ~25 bps per pair trade
Co-integration breaks during regime changes — a pair that worked last month may diverge permanently
Leg risk: one leg fills, the other doesn't, leaving you with a naked directional position
prior_art: Classic pairs trading (Gatev, Goetzmann, Rouwenhorst 2006). Indian market adaptation.
notes: Pre-compute and validate pairs universe weekly. Good candidates: HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK, TCS/INFY, RELIANCE/ONGC, SBIN/BANKBARODA.
